added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite and no after_suite gate log (its test_logs lists gate-tests.log, a 1684-passed run over tests/discovery tests/ids tests/cli/test_discover_map.py), so no base arm exists to derive the added-failure count from.

findings.text: the tests field reports a "regression gate: 1684 passed" but gate-tests.log runs only tests/discovery tests/ids tests/cli/test_discover_map.py; the node's evidence fence also names tests/test_cli.py, tests/wiki/test_graph_ops_unit.py and tests/standard_names/test_atomic_refined_name_persistence.py, test_pool_orchestrator_integration.py and test_review_axis_scoped_writes.py, none of which executed, and claims.py's release_* signature change is imported widely so those targets are not irrelevant.

the gate log's first line is the pytest session banner, so the log names no revision, tree or command and cannot be tied to 70eb1c178 without the run's stream; the review contract requires a gate log's first line to name the revision it ran at, the tree and the command.

_capture_decisions_cost replaces imas_codex.ids.candidates.call_decisions at runtime for the duration of the candidate worker and is untested, because test_cost_limit_stops_the_loop monkeypatches _capture_decisions_cost itself, so no test reddens if the wrapper stops routing cost; the plan section 7 audit accepts this as a design defect repaired in section 10.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 2144115d1; the single commit 70eb1c178 changes seven files (+1286/-161), generalising the claim helpers into claims.py, adding the candidate worker and engine to workers.py, adding the discover map command, and adding tests/cli/test_discover_map.py and tests/discovery/test_claims_field.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: the plan's done-when names a CliRunner test with fake retrieval and a fake transport over three fixture sources, and tests/cli/test_discover_map.py carries test_candidate_worker_writes_one_route_per_source (one source per route), test_cost_limit_stops_the_loop, test_status_domain_map_prints_route_counts and test_clear_domain_map_removes_candidates; I reproduced both new files green at head (13 passed).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to add the `discover map` candidate stage and its CLI command on section 7's generalised claim routines, and the landed diff adds claim_batch/has_pending and the claimed_field keyword on release_* in imas_codex/discovery/base/claims.py, candidate_worker/run_candidate_engine in imas_codex/ids/workers.py, and imas_codex/cli/discover/map.py with the five option names section 7 names (imas_codex/cli/discover/map.py:30-64).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the commit, the 1684-passed gate in gate-tests.log, the negative control and its note, and a follow-on for the discarded decisions cost, but it records no baseline_suite or after_suite and its tests field does not name the gate's target set (FINDING at manifest.md:15).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares seven write paths and git show --stat 70eb1c178 lists exactly those seven files, the two granted docs/evidence and docs/figures paths being absent because the done-when names no artifact.

justifications.durability: skipping route_ids reddens test_candidate_worker_scopes_retrieval_to_routed_ids (negative-control.log, EXIT=1) against hardcoded expected IDSs, but the runtime call_decisions patch in _capture_decisions_cost is untested because test_cost_limit_stops_the_loop substitutes that wrapper (FINDING at imas_codex/ids/workers.py:978).
justifications.evidence: I reproduced the two new test files green at head (13 passed), but the recorded gate-tests.log covers only tests/discovery tests/ids tests/cli/test_discover_map.py while the node's evidence fence also names tests/test_cli.py, tests/wiki/test_graph_ops_unit.py and three tests/standard_names files that never ran (FINDING at manifest.md:15).
justifications.fit: the field-constant tuples, CandidateDiscoveryState and the generic routines follow the surrounding imas_codex/ids/workers.py idiom and carry no plan or ticket identifier, though replacing a module attribute at runtime is a fit smell the plan section 7 audit accepts for section 10.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/ids/workers.py:1053 and :1282 add candidate_worker and run_candidate_engine, imas_codex/discovery/base/claims.py:255 adds claim_batch and :335 has_pending, and imas_codex/cli/discover/map.py:30 registers the five reused option names, exactly the section 7 surface.
justifications.reuse: workers.py's seven claim helpers now delegate to the shared owner imas_codex/discovery/base/claims.py:255 and the candidate pipeline reuses imas_codex/ids/candidates.py route_ids/retrieve_candidates/judge_candidates/route and imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py write_candidates rather than forking them.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat 70eb1c178 lists exactly the seven files the manifest declares, imas_codex/cli/discover/common.py among them because the dispatch granted it, and the granted docs/evidence and docs/figures paths are untouched.
